children: China's securities watchdog has allowed its stock exchanges to  lower the minimum margin ratio for investors buying securities on credit to 80% from 100%, the Shanghai Stock Exchange said on Sunday.
The change will take effect on November 30, according to the exchange's statement.

In a separate announcement, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has proposed rules governing a market-making mechanism in ChiNext-board stocks, a step it said is aimed at making the market more stable and resilient.
The stock exchange also said it will waive trading unit fees for 2026 and extend a range of other fee waivers through 2028, to cut costs for market participants.
